Description Welcome to 'Beach Bliss on 30A,'  a breathtaking retreat in the heart of Seagrove offering the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm. Just steps away from the pristine sands of Seagrove Beach, this is your ideal getaway destination for relaxation and adventure. This stunning 4 bed/4.5 bath home is located in a small gated community which offers privacy and a gorgeous multi-level pool for your enjoyment. We include 6 bikes and a golf cart to enjoy all that scenic 30A has to offer! ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 10 people: FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bedroom #2:  (2) Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR: Bedroom #3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower THIRD FLOOR: Bedroom #4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower BEACH ACCESS Three access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. Eastern Lake Beach Access is on the west side of Eastern Lake where the outfall meets the beach at the intersection of South Gulf Drive and Eastern Lake Road, about 1/4 mile south of Scenic 30A. The access has a shower, a bike rack, and a few parking spaces on Eastern Lake Drive. Eastern Lake is one of our rare coastal dune lakes in SoWal, which periodically open to exchange waters with the gulf. 2. Ramsgate Beach Access is a simple walkover near the end of Eastern Lake Road behind Summers Edge neighborhood beside Ramsgate townhomes. This access does not have parking or showers. 3. Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.6 miles East of the home) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. FEATURES 6-Seater Golf Cart  6 Bikes Multi-Level Community Pool with Fireplace & Sunset Tower Gated Community Steps from Beach 2 Covered Balconies Fully Stocked Kitchen Coffee Maker Outdoor Grill- Natural Gas Smart TVs Beach Gear **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING This home includes 2 parking space on the driveway with NO overflow parking available. No RV or trailer parking in the driveway. Violator's will be towed. ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. Seagrove is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm. You will find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party s needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.  *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *This home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie".
